name: Albino Ripper Queen
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production static game enemy sprite, original project adaptation. Image 1: base anatomy, crown and raster material reference. Create ONE newly authored Albino Ripper Queen, massive armored royal in non-attacking grounded idle. PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed project-original V66 enemy-024-ripper-queen royal identity. Preserve one massive royal Xenomorph with a broad backward-swept segmented crown, pale jagged dorsal carapace and tendrils, black-derived wet biomechanical inner tissue, restrained neural fissures, two reinforced primary forelimbs plus the small inner royal arms, two massive digitigrade hindlegs and exactly one long segmented hooked tail permanently attached to the pelvis. The Albino modifier changes organic pigment and material response only: dark inner tissue becomes warm pearl, pale parchment and cool ash-gray with restrained rose-taupe recesses; crown and dorsal armor remain distinct brighter chalk-ivory/aged bone, with restrained dark burgundy fissures. Never apply a flat whole-body white filter. Keep strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile and the queue's royal family of five clips, including tail-strike. Tail-strike must anticipate, sweep the single attached tail through a readable hit phase and recover without changing body proportions; the tail is never a held spear, detached weapon or second limb. Do not inherit the predecessor's numeric scale, legacy bounds roots, attack border contacts, magenta residue or subtle near-duplicate timing. No standard blue Queen recolor, ATARAX Ripper downsizing, firearm, second tail, copied predecessor pixels or official/canon-exact claim. Every future pixel must be original fan-made/project art; canonExact=false and no 1:1 claim.
Critical: show ALL FOUR arms separately and completely: near massive primary arm hangs down-forward, far massive primary arm extends slightly farther forward, two much smaller chest arms are held above them with visible complete hands. Avoid any arm completely hiding another. Two powerful digitigrade feet planted, full broad jagged crown and entire single long attached tail visible behind left. ONE character only, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing side profile. Real transparent alpha, no floor/shadow/halo. Fit complete silhouette in central 75% canvas with at least 10% clear transparent margin each edge. No sprite sheet, grid, repeated subjects, text, logos, watermark, weapons, gore or crop. One static pose only.

reference.visualNotes: Reviewed base sheet: massive royal with jagged segmented crown/dorsal plates, reinforced primary limbs, inner royal arms and attached segmented tail.

review.notes: All four arms identifiable (two large lower primary arms and two smaller chest arms), two feet and one complete attached tail. Layered pale crown and burgundy fissures retained. Native alpha and intact silhouette; lateral padding 4.4-5.2%. Static adaptation only.
